nom: Banila Co Clean It Zero Pore Clarifying Cleansing Balm

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the balm removes makeup and sunscreen effectively without clogging pores or causing breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin report it leaves skin clean and hydrated rather than stripped, including one reviewer whose skin used to feel dry and irritated with other removers.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it melts off a full face of makeup while leaving skin surprisingly hydrated rather than stripped or tight.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or eczema, overwhelmingly report no irritation or breakouts and describe the balm as gentle enough for daily use around the eyes; one reviewer with sensitive skin found it irritated and burned on first use.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes that as her skin has matured it has become more prone to dryness and irritation around the eyes, which this balm has helped avoid.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the balm leaves skin clean and hydrated rather than stripped or tight, even on dry and sensitive skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation or redness, and one notes their skin looks smoother and less red since switching to it, though two reviewers describe a rash, swelling, or a burning/tingling reaction.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or oily skin report no breakouts and some note fewer breakouts and clearer pores over time, though one reviewer felt a reformulation made it less effective against their acne than the original.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report it cuts through excess oil, sunscreen, and makeup while keeping pores clean.

aspects.libelle: Melts makeup and waterproof products easily
Can blur vision or sting when it gets in eyes
Rich, buttery texture that rinses clean without residue
Some feel it leaves a slightly oily or waxy film
Comes with a useful spatula and reseals well

extraits.texte: I had high hopes for this product with all the great reviews, however when I tried it not only did it irritate my sensitive skin (it tingled/red/burned) it also didn't clean right .Unfortunately I cannot use this and would not recommend with anyone with sensitive skin.
I used this before with no issues but this time I woke up with swollen blurry eyes and a rash all over my face.

I have VERY acne prone skin. I love this stuff because it really cleans my makeup off before I go in with my acne cleanser. I've had no irritation or breakouts from it, and love that the ingredients are doing more than just removing my makeup. I wear waterproof mascara and do my whole face with one scoop, then go in with a second small scoop to really get my mascara off. works great and doesn't make my eyes all blurry like other balms do. also, I didn't realize it until opening my second jar, but keep that little plastic thingy that your spatula comes packaged in! i thought it was just packaging and tossed it when I opened my first jar. its made to fit perfectly inside the jar and keep your spatula separate. it may sound silly to some, but I didn't know it so I just wanted to throw that out there for others who also may not!

I have tried the avocado version of this and love it and the original was no exception! I am obsessed with how hydrated it leaves my skin without making it greasy. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this does not irritate it at all. 10/10 would recommend. I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

extraits.titre: Removes makeup and leaves my skin glowing
extraits.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I have oily, acne-prone skin, and finding a makeup remover that deeply cleans without clogging pores has been a challenge. From the first use, I was impressed. This balm melts into a silky oil that instantly breaks down waterproof makeup and sunscreen without needing to scrub. It rinses off easily, doesn't blur my eyes, and leaves my skin clean, soft, and surprisingly hydrated—with no greasy residue. The texture feels luxurious, the scent is light and pleasant, and the packaging is sleek. I genuinely look forward to using it every night. One of the best I've tried.

extraits.titre: Impressed by the Hype! Great for Combo Skin.
extraits.texte: So excited to try the much-hyped Clean it Zero Original Balm. This product was gifted for my honest review. I've seen it all over social media prior to trying it. With combo skin, I was curious how it would handle makeup. It truly delivers! Melts off a full face easily & rinses totally clean, no greasy residue. The best part? It's surprisingly hydrating for my combination skin! Left my face feeling soft and moisturized, not stripped or tight at all. My sensitive skin has done well with this Original, but for daily use, I'm keen to try their Purifying (sensitive skin) version next. Overall, a fantastic experience. This balm is effective, gentle, and worked wonderfully for my combo skin. Highly recommend giving it a shot!
